dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, I heard the university in Toronto accepted you. Congratulations!
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, aɪ ˈhɜːrd ðə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti ɪn təˈrɑːntoʊ əkˈsɛptɪd juː. kənˌɡrætʃəˈleɪʃənz!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thank you! I'm going to study there for one semester.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː! aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈstʌdi ˈðɛr fər ˈwʌn səˈmɛstər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: In January, if everything goes well. I'm meeting the exchange adviser on Friday to talk about it.
dialogue.reading: ɪn ˈdʒænjuɛri, ɪf ˈɛvriθɪŋ ˈɡoʊz ˈwɛl. aɪm ˈmiːtɪŋ ði ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ ədˈvaɪzər ɑːn ˈfraɪdeɪ tə ˈtɔːk əˈbaʊt ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: The scholarship. If I don't get it, I'm not certain I can go.
dialogue.reading: ðə ˈskɑːlərʃɪp. ɪf aɪ ˈdoʊnt ˈɡɛt ɪt, aɪm ˈnɑːt ˈsɜːrtən aɪ kən ˈɡoʊ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Is it likely that you'll get it?
dialogue.reading: ɪz ɪt ˈlaɪkli ðæt juːl ˈɡɛt ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: The adviser says it's likely, but nothing is predictable with scholarships.
dialogue.reading: ði ədˈvaɪzər ˈsɛz ɪts ˈlaɪkli, bʌt ˈnʌθɪŋ ɪz prɪˈdɪktəbəl wɪð ˈskɑːlərʃɪps.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: What do you intend to do if you don't get it?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt duː juː ɪnˈtɛnd tə ˈduː ɪf juː ˈdoʊnt ˈɡɛt ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I intend to work every weekend and save money. I'll go anyway!
dialogue.reading: aɪ ɪnˈtɛnd tə ˈwɜːrk ˈɛvri ˈwiːkɛnd ənd ˈseɪv ˈmʌni. aɪl ˈɡoʊ ˈɛniweɪ!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Good for you! I'll write a letter for your scholarship application, then.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd fər ˈjuː! aɪl ˈraɪt ə ˈlɛtər fər jʊr ˈskɑːlərʃɪp ˌæplɪˈkeɪʃən, ˈðɛn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Really? Thank you so much, Mr. Brown!
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? ˈθæŋk juː ˈsoʊ ˈmʌtʃ, ˈmɪstər ˈbraʊn!
